concerns.text: FR-012 requires that for NEW INFERENCE INPUTS the system logs a warning and SKIPS the molecule. T002/T007 implement only the test-set retention path ('retain test molecules, log a summary'). No task implements the inference-time skip behavior, so FR-012 is only partially covered. Add a task (or extend T004/T005) covering the inference-time skip path.

The constitution requires a pinned requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at projects/PROJ-218-.../code/. No task creates or pins this file; T005 references code/config/gnn_config.yaml but dependency pinning is absent. Add it to T005 or a setup task.

SC-005 specifies a random baseline of 100 draws; T010 runs '10,000 random draws' and adds a p < 0.05 requirement the spec never states. The task's verification criteria do not match the spec's success criterion — align draw count and pass conditions (or amend the spec).

Spec's spot-check is for a single high-FQY molecule ('a molecule... selected as one of the top-5'); T010 requires the check to pass for all five highest-FQY test molecules, silently strengthening the acceptance criterion without a spec change.

T009's SHAP sanity check records the IG-SHAP Pearson correlation but drops the plan's ≥ 0.7 reliability gate; also plan Phase 6's 'bias analysis (metrics with vs. without unseen-type molecules)' has no corresponding task in T007. Either add these plan elements to tasks or mark them optional consistently.

Plan Phase 1 mandates an automatic rebalance to 70/15/15 when the test set has < 40 molecules; no task implements this plan element (T003 keeps 80/10/10 per FR-013). The plan/tasks divergence leaves a plan element uncovered — resolve the plan-spec contradiction so coverage is unambiguous.
